description: This file defines the interface 'GenericTarget', which serves as a super type for target-related classes such as targets and reply-targets in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It provides methods to retrieve the address for outgoing messages and optionally a header mapping configuration.

classes.name: GenericTarget
classes.description: An interface representing the common super type for targets and reply targets, providing essential information for message dispatching.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address for an outbound signal.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Provides an optional header mapping to rename or combine headers for an outbound signal, allowing placeholders for 'thing:*' and 'header:*'.
